subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and if so should it be a Feishu-specific option or part of a shared channel media-ingestion policy?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented config contract, while adding an equivalent behavior expands channel config/default behavior and affects how existing Feishu media is processed.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to the current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Media Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical setting across channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports only `mediaMaxMb` and does not offer a file-content ignore switch.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to the current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.
